verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented call analytics or reporting feature showing call volume, answer rate, or missed calls broken down per number and per teammate. The MCP server can retrieve call history and missed-call details, but these are raw-data building blocks a user would have to aggregate themselves, not the reporting capability the story asks for. The vague line "Spot issues before they cost your business" does not describe any metrics.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate
